blocks.secondary_RANGE_PLUS_DOPPLER_PLUS_DDOR: NOT evaluated (no DeltaDOR search in CD1)

bug_policy: IMPLEMENTATION_BUG_FIX logged, preregistration preserved, affected results re-run and decision fields compared; a change of the experiment definition => PREDECLARATION_INVALIDATED

classes.FIDELITY_EFFECT: POP(D0) differs HF vs SIMPLIFIED -> FIDELITY_CHANGES_POPULATION_VERDICT; else RMS over cells of (delta_HF - delta_SIMP) > 0.02 -> FIDELITY_MATERIAL_VERDICT_STABLE; else FIDELITY_NEGLIGIBLE
classes.NUISANCE_RETENTION: cells with delta_D0 > 0.02: median delta_D1FREE / delta_D0 >= 0.75 RETAINED; >= 0.25 PARTIALLY_RETAINED; else LOST; no such cell -> NOT_APPLICABLE_NO_IDEAL_GAIN
classes.decomposition: per cell: d(range f), d(Doppler-only f), d(combined f), d(delta), HF - SIMPLIFIED, D0

count_interval.justification: 60 s = production default and HARDEN/F1-qualified value; Moyer M2 'e.g. 60 s or 600 s'; 202E figures use 5/60/1000 s
count_interval.rule: cadence >= Tc so counts never overlap (independent white noise per count); 540 s = 6 grid steps, midpoints on every 6th node

decision_tree.A: COUNTED_DOPPLER_ROBUSTLY_ADDS_K_SRP_DIRECTION: POP(D0) and POP(D1 FREE) and ABS
decision_tree.B: COUNTED_DOPPLER_ROBUSTLY_IMPROVES_DIRECTION_BUT_K_REMAINS_WEAK: POP(D0) and POP(D1 FREE) and not ABS
decision_tree.alternative_parameterization: justified as the next characterization for C, D or E
decision_tree.nonlinear_confirmation: may become justified only for A or B (never started automatically)

doppler_schedule.PRIMARY: ALL_VISIBLE: one row per (90 s grid node, DSN3 station visible there) - the production candidate rule - kept only if every grid node from floor(t_mid - Tc/2) to ceil(t_mid + Tc/2) is in the same visibility window; HistoryDomainError candidates dropped (production)
doppler_schedule.SECONDARY: REGULAR_SESSION: per station pass lasting >= 3600 s, the rows within the centred 3600 s
doppler_schedule.not_used: no K-informed selection, no schedule search; DeltaDOR not included in any primary block

dynamics.CONTROL: SIMPLIFIED: phase17_r1od2_core.propagate_nom48, same cells, decomposition only; never decides
dynamics.PRIMARY: HIGH_FIDELITY: phase17_r1od2_fidelity.propagate_fidelity (GL1800F 50x50 MOON_PA_DE440, Earth + Sun third body, production SRP + F1 position gradient, harmonic STM opt-in, rtol 1e-12) for EVERY orbit x epoch cell
dynamics.fallback: none needed (feasibility measured: simplified cell ~13 s, HF ~330 s)
dynamics.matrix: FULL 5 orbits x 24 epochs x {HF, SIMPLIFIED}; one propagation per cell reused by all schedules

fd_spot_checks.analytic: production Jacobian on the HF propagation at rtol 1e-12
fd_spot_checks.arc: 2 canonical orbits (FD tractability), same x0 / epoch / HF force model

gates.COUNTED_DOPPLER_STATE_FD_GATE: every state column <= 1e-5 in both cases

fd_spot_checks.metric: per column min over steps of ||fd - an|| / ||an|| over the 6 rows
fd_spot_checks.oracle: central differences of the production observable on repropagated HF trajectories at rtol 1e-13, atol 1e-14; steps x {10, 100} m, v {0.01, 0.1} m/s, K {1e-3, 3e-3} m^2/kg
fd_spot_checks.rows: 6 Doppler rows per case, evenly spaced over the ALL_VISIBLE Tc 60 rows

forbidden: schedule optimisation or K-informed row selection
DeltaDOR epoch / baseline / session / phase < 60 deg search
rank(H^T W H) as an observability gate

hypotheses.H1: counted Doppler adds a more robust K-specific direction than DeltaDOR did
hypotheses.H2: range + Doppler gain persists across epoch and orbit under HF dynamics
hypotheses.H3: the direction survives Doppler nuisance freedom

implementation: phase17_r1od2_core.info_metrics (QR projector f_perp, R1COV QR sigma_K, SVD); rank(H^T W H) is NOT an observability gate

independent_rebuild.doppler_rows: every HF cell, 12 rows: R4 four-event module (M3 3x3 implicit sensitivity) at zero delay vs production R3 rows; state rel <= 1e-9, K abs / max|h_K| <= 1e-9
independent_rebuild.f_perp: every HF primary cell: lstsq route (phase17_r1o_cd1_core.independent_f_perp) for DOPPLER_ONLY D0, RANGE_PLUS_DOPPLER D0, D1 FREE, D2 FREE and D1 prior 1e-4: |diff| <= 1e-10
independent_rebuild.nuisance_ownership: each nuisance column non-zero only on its own pass's Doppler rows; range rows zero
independent_rebuild.range_k_column: every HF cell, 12 range rows: dx/dK-in-STM-slot (event-epoch interpolation) through two_way_range_nominal_and_initial_jacobian vs production _two_way_range_k_srp_column (H_x0 Phi(t3)^-1 S_K(t3) at the receive-tag node, Phase 17A-R qualified to 4.9e-8); abs / max|h_K| <= 1e-7 (pre-measured before any metric: 2.7e-9, CANON k0 SIMPLIFIED)
independent_rebuild.whitening: Doppler w == 1/sigma^2 exactly; range w == 1/5^2 exactly

metrics: weakest right-singular vector and its K component

noise.OPERATIONAL_LOWER_BOUND: per row: 202E Eq (30) X/X (C_band 2.7e-6) at the midpoint Sun-Earth-spacecraft angle, T = 60 s, RSS 2.12e-6 m/s H-maser floor; thermal PARAMETRIC and excluded -> optimistic lower bound
noise.PRIMARY: STRUCTURAL_REFERENCE sigma_D = 1.0e-4 m/s at Tc = 60 s, white, per row (repository DSN sigma_range_rate_mps; inside 202E X/X scintillation span at 60 s)

nuisance.PRIMARY: D1_SESSION_CONSTANT_BIAS, FREE (no operational prior is claimed)
nuisance.design_unit: nuisance parameters in units of 1e-4 m/s for the scaled SVD; f_perp invariant

models.D1_SESSION_CONSTANT_BIAS: one constant range-rate bias per station pass (frequency / slowly varying media offset over a pass)
models.D2_SESSION_BIAS_PLUS_LINEAR_DRIFT: D1 plus a linear drift per pass, regressor (t - t_mid)/half_span in [-1, 1]

observable.earth: canonical FXR fixture, linear interpolation inside the counted path (R3-P22 / HARDEN-D23)
observable.function: lunar_od.radiometrics.two_way_counted_doppler_observable / _initial_state_jacobian (production default R3 exact-station model == R4 four-event at zero delay)
observable.k_column: production Jacobian with dx/dK placed in the first STM column (HARDEN/F1 construction)
observable.units: mps_equivalent (rate of change of one-way range, m/s)

CANON.source: campaign epoch + campaign x0 (FXR canonical, GEO G0_consistent)

population.POP(X): fraction(delta_X > 0) >= 0.75 AND fraction(delta_X > 0.02) >= 0.50 over feasible cells
population.cells: HF, RANGE_PLUS_DOPPLER, ALL_VISIBLE, Tc 60 s, sigma 1e-4 m/s; 5 orbits x 24 epochs = 120; feasible = >= 7 Doppler rows

production_defect_policy: a real production correctness defect stops the science campaign; isolate and recommend a repair; no silent production repair

anchors: CANON SIMPLIFIED range f_perp, all 24 k, vs artifacts/phase17_r1od3_primary_results.csv (1e-12)
all orbits HF and SIMPLIFIED range f_perp at k = 4..11 vs artifacts/phase17_r1od4_raw_results.json (1e-12)
range_baseline.definition: phase17_r1od2_core.build_range_block on the SAME propagation (orbit, epoch, dynamics, visibility), production two-way range, DSN3, sigma 5 m (station.sigma_range_m), no range bias

representative_cells.signature: corr(Doppler h_K, LOS . dv/dK), corr(range h_K, LOS . dr/dK); share of Doppler-row orthogonal energy within +-1 h of eclipse transitions and within +-10 min of pass start/end, vs the row fraction
representative_cells.time_localization: cumulative range+Doppler and Doppler-only f_perp and I(K|x) using rows with t <= tau, tau = 10..100% of the arc; LOCALIZED if one 10% slice adds > 50% of the final combined I(K|x), else BROAD

truth_level: SYNTHETIC_CAMPAIGN_TRUTH (K_truth = 0.01 m^2/kg, constant scalar K; no reparameterization)
